articles.title: Crypto analytics firm Chainalysis proposes standards for blockchain tracing
articles.snippet: The blockchain analysis company published a proposed ontology for how investigators can identify clusters of crypto addresses and link them together.

articles.title: Tether's USDT jumps to 8.5% premium in India after crypto payment crackdown
articles.snippet: Raids on crypto payment firms in Bengaluru disrupted the pipeline that feeds dollar-pegged USDT to Indian platforms, pushing its local price more than 8.5% above the dollar, roughly double the usual gap.

articles.title: Germany leads MiCA crypto authorization race as Europe’s deadline looms
articles.snippet: MiCA crypto licensing data shows 244 approved companies across EU and EEA jurisdictions, led by Germany with France and the Netherlands also among top hubs ahead of July 1 cliff.

articles.title: Binance booted from EU, EthLabs rises up to save Ethereum: Hodler's Digest June 14-28
articles.snippet: BitMine and Joe Lubin back a new non profit called Ethlabs that aims to spur adoption. Binance shutters services in Europe after failing to secure a license.

articles.title: BitGo Joins Crypto's AI Layoff Wave, Slashing Staff by 15%
articles.snippet: The newly public crypto custodian is slashing nearly 15% of its workforce as it pivots to focus on stablecoins and AI infrastructure.
